thread:
Mike (sec-eng): heads up — since ~05:20 UTC we're seeing a wave of user sessions drop in eu-west. App logs show SAML responses OK but session validation failing with 'session_fingerprint_mismatch'. Anyone else seeing correlated alerts?

Sasha (infra): :eyes: yep, auth-proxy 502s spiked right around 05:18–05:22. Getting repeated KMS errors in token-store: `Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException`.

Priya (prod-sso): we deployed a small session key rotation at 05:15 as part of the cookie signing rollout (non-breaking according to canary). Could be timing overlap. rolling back would be quick if that's the cause.

Dani (oncall): before rollback — can we confirm whether the session verification checks the key via KMS alias or stores raw key locally? aka does an alias swap in KMS cause immediate mismatches?

Sasha (infra): our code uses KMS envelope encryption for token encryption. We fetch a data key encrypted with KMS using an alias `alias/sso-signing-eu`. If alias updated to a different key version without rewrapping tokens, decrypt will fail.

Nikhil (devex): SCIM provisioning pipeline also started failing for a subset of users ~05:19. Errors look like `403 KMS: AccessDenied` from the provisioning worker. Possibly a policy or rotation touched the key resource policy.

idp-bot: Incoming Okta hook: "user_session.invalidate events = 118 over 4m — trigger reason: fingerprint_mismatch" — payload snippet attached.

Mike (sec-eng): ok — hypothesis: deployment rotated KMS alias to a new key version + changed key policy (or removed role) so existing encrypted tokens can't decrypt, causing session verification to treat fingerprint as invalid. Action plan: 1) confirm alias change & key policy 2) if alias swap happened, revert alias to previous key version 3) re-encrypt tokens gradually or fallback to allow re-login with minimal user impact.

Priya (prod-sso): I did push a key rotation script that updated alias pointer as part of the deploy. I thought the worker would rewrap tokens on first write, but I didn't realize the preview can flip alias immediately. Sorry.

Dani (oncall): can you dump the alias history? I'll also check CloudTrail-equivalent audit for KMS calls.

Sasha (infra): pulling KMS audit now. snippet:```text
2026-03-21T05:15:12Z PutKeyPolicy - user:deploy-bot - alias/rotate -> success
2026-03-21T05:15:13Z UpdateAlias - alias/sso-signing-eu -> key/abcd-NEW
2026-03-21T05:18:03Z Decrypt - user:token-service - key/abcd-OLD -> InvalidCiphertextException
```

Nikhil (devex): also seeing `AccessDenied` from provisioning because the worker's role was missing the new CMK ARN in its allowed principals — policy edit likely removed previous role binding.

Mike (sec-eng): roll back alias to key/abcd-OLD now? Are there any compliance constraints on reusing old key? We need to coordinate with security and compliance if reusing keys.

Priya (prod-sso): short term I'd prefer alias rollback to restore session stability. We'll open a compliance note and do a formal re-encrypt workflow for stored tokens.

Dani (oncall): executing alias rollback in 2m — will post when done. Meanwhile pausing the session-rotation job.

Sasha (infra): FYI command I ran locally to inspect alias mapping: `aws kms list-aliases --key-id alias/sso-signing-eu --region eu-west-1` — returned alias -> key/abcd-NEW. After rollback we should see alias -> key/abcd-OLD.

Dani (oncall): rolled back alias @ 05:34 UTC. quick smoke: auth-proxy 502s down to baseline, token-store decrypt errors dropped to 0. Okta invalidation events reduced sharply. :thumbsup:

Mike (sec-eng): nice. Next steps: - Priya & security to document why rotation script updated alias immediately (expected behavior vs safe pattern) - Nikhil to add CI gate to ensure worker roles are in key policy before alias swap - Sasha to add monitoring alert for KMS Decrypt failure rate spike - Dani to create incident ticket and attach audit trail + timeline.

Priya (prod-sso): agreed. I'll open an RFC for staged rotation: create new key version, add principal to key policy, rewrap tokens on write for a window, then update alias when zero decrypt-errors for 15m.

Nikhil (devex): I'll add a `(pre-rotate) key-policy-check` job in the pipeline and a script to bulk rewrap tokens with concurrency limits. Also add a post-check to verify SCIM worker can decrypt new key (test principal decrypt).

idp-bot: Okta reports sessions returning to normal. No new invalidate spikes in the last 10m.

Mike (sec-eng): marking as triaged for now. Dani, please create P1 incident with RCA label and include these bullet points. We'll follow up with postmortem and a playbook item for KMS-backed session rotations. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
summary: KMS alias swap during session key rotation caused decrypt failures -> session_fingerprint_mismatch and SCIM provisioning errors; alias rolled back, services recovered; plan for staged rotation and policy gating created.
